His medical history is significant for chronic emotional disturbances. A Glianorex Imagery Sonography (GIS) reveals morphological changes in the Glioceptors and disrupted neural networks. Given these findings, which of the following best characterizes the pathophysiological process impacting his condition?

options.C: Dysregulated feedback loop involving immune responses, genetic predispositions, and environmental triggers without hormonal imbalance
options.D: Aberrant synaptic pruning and neural aberrations in the Glioceptors without significant hormonal fluctuations impacting neurotransmitter release
options.F: I don't know or cannot answer
